title: Deferred then discussed: the apartment
description: Roommates talk about a work presentation; Kwame says they should talk about the apartment later, then they discuss a TV show, and finally come back to the lease. Expect a pending node about the apartment raised early that ends resolved and links to the later lease discussion.

utterances.text: How did your presentation go? You were so nervous this morning.
It went fine, actually. The demo crashed once but I just made a joke and restarted it.
That's the best way to handle it. Did your boss say anything?
She said the slides were too dense. Which, fair, I had like forty bullet points.
Classic you. Next time do three slides and just talk.
Yeah. Oh, we should talk about the apartment later, the landlord emailed about renewing.
Oh no, okay. Is it bad?
Kind of, but let's do it properly after dinner. Did you finish the season finale?
Yes! I can't believe they killed off the sister. I actually yelled at the TV.
Right? I thought she was the main character for next season.
Apparently the actress wanted to leave to do movies. So they just wrote her out.
That explains why the last three episodes felt rushed.
Totally. The flashback episode was the best one though.
Agreed. Okay, so, the apartment. The landlord wants to raise the rent by eight percent if we sign another year.
Eight percent? That's like a hundred and sixty dollars more each month.
Yeah. Or we can go month to month, but then it's twelve percent.
That's ridiculous. Isn't there a legal cap on increases in BC?
There is, I think it's three point five this year. So eight is probably not even allowed.
Then we push back. Can you forward me the email? I want to check the exact numbers.
Already forwarded, it should be in your inbox.
